versions.description: Audit fixes: FedoraKDE move recorded, relocatable harness launcher, thermal-doc correction, battery unit, sleep enforcement documented

features.title: OOM containment: harness.slice + oom-guard + launcher
features.notes: L1 harness.slice 18G/4G with ManagedOOMMemoryPressure=auto, L2 omit on WezTerm/Plasma via 10 s guard, launcher raises oom_score_adj=900 inside the scope. Proven in production: kernel cgroup OOM killed nocowboy inside harness.slice, terminal survived.

features.title: Harness launcher independent of the external drive
features.notes: oom-guard.sh now installs harness-run.sh into ~/.local/lib/no-cowboy/ and links ~/.local/bin/harness to that copy; a symlink into the repo died when the external drive was unmounted (reviewer follow-up #2).

features.title: Correct thermal analysis: display topology is the idle-power driver
features.notes: fbdev=1 is a driver default on nvidia-open 615, not a GRUB flag; DP-1 + HDMI-A-1 are on the dGPU so it never idles (35-52 W). Balanced profile is not the quiet profile on this EC (fan blow-up). Doc now carries the measured chain and the card2 (DP-2/DP-3) test.

features.title: Battery charge limit unit uses asusctl (not BAT1 sysfs)
features.notes: systemd/battery-charge-limit.service wrote to /sys/class/power_supply/BAT1/charge_control_end_threshold, which does not exist on this model. Rewritten to asusctl battery limit 80 via asusd. Not installed by default; enabling it applies the 80% cap.

features.title: Enforce the sleep decision (mask sleep targets)
features.notes: SLEEP-WAKE-ISSUES.md says sleep is disabled, but the targets are static, not masked. Root step documented in the doc: systemctl mask sleep.target suspend.target hibernate.target hybrid-sleep.target. Needs a human with sudo.

features.title: Move an external monitor to the iGPU to lower dGPU idle power
features.notes: card2 (Intel) exposes DP-2 and DP-3; DP-1/HDMI-A-1 are on card1 (NVIDIA). Measure nvidia-smi power.draw and fan*_input before/after moving a cable (or lowering refresh to 60). Target: dGPU under 20 W idle.

features.title: SYSTEM-STATE.md and roadmap.json reflect 2026-11-10
features.notes: The state doc was frozen at 2024-12-30 (kernel 6.18.2-zen2); a verified current-state section now precedes the historical record, and the roadmap is no longer empty.

features.title: Record the FedoraKDE kit move out of the repo
features.notes: The kit lives at LinuxDCO/misc_os/FedoraKDE next to the NixOS kit (38 files, identical content plus assets/). The misleading 'refresh' commit was rewritten to describe the move.
